x: Nigel Morris, John Dunsford and Stuart Bennett are now expressing their wishes to form a greater part in the team, hence the extra training (and the national trophy).

John Dunsford, Nigel Morris and myself all set personal best times and that in itself is quite amazing. John knows the score in these races but Nigel did incredibly well during the training period and, of course, in the race.
We did have some excuses as the season progressed, with John Hall gallivanting off to South Africa, Graham Seatter off the road with a cracked bone and Nigel Morris taking a tumble on his motorcycle.

Sixth was Jonathon Dunsford, 25:47, 11th Nigel Morris, 26:24, and 14th Stuart Bennett, 27:06. Stuart had placed 6th with 46:50 in a LPR 9 kilometre yacht handicap at Blackheath Park three days earlier.
In the 10,000m Junior Nigel Morris 20th in 56:06 and Stu Bennett 11th in 57:38 were obviously not at their best but worked hard against the odds.
